message.content:
**MSFT** is the stock‑symbol used by **Yahoo! Finance** (and most other financial platforms) to identify **Microsoft Corp.**, one of the largest publicly traded companies worldwide.  

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| Symbol | `MSFT` |
| Exchange | NASDAQ Global Select Market |
| Ticker type | Common Stock |
| Sector / Industry | Technology – Software & Services |
| Headquarters | Redmond, Washington, USA |
| Current price* | $[price] per share *(updated daily)* |
| Market Cap | ~$2–$3 trillion USD (as of latest close) |

> *Note:* Prices fluctuate throughout each trading day based on supply/demand dynamics. For real‑time quotes or historical data you’ll typically see “Last Trade” prices displayed next to the ticker on Yahoo! Finance’s page.

If you’re looking at an article or chart labeled **“MSFT”**, it’s referencing this company’s equity performance—its price movements, volume, earnings releases, analyst ratings, dividend history, and so forth—all aggregated from exchanges where its shares trade.
